typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		EID as string,
		ELID as string,
		{ZONE NAME} as string,
		{ZONE VALID FROM} as string,
		{ZONE VALID TO} as string,
		{FIRST NAME} as string,
		{LAST NAME} as string,
		EMAIL as string,
		{JOB TITLE} as string,
		{AVAILABLE TO WORK} as string,
		{HIRE DATE} as string,
		{EXPECTED END DATE} as string,
		{VENDOR COMPANY} as string,
		{MANAGER FIRST NAME} as string,
		{MANAGER LAST NAME} as string,
		{MANAGER EMAIL} as string,
		{MANAGER NAME} as string,
		{ACCESS KEEPER ID} as string,
		{ZONE OWNER EMAIL} as string,
		{ZONE GROUP} as string,
		{CAMPUS SET} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName,
		ZONEVALIDFROM = iif(isNull({ZONE VALID FROM}) || trim({ZONE VALID FROM}) == '', toTimestamp(null()), toTimestamp(toString({ZONE VALID FROM}, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')),
		ZONEVALIDTO = iif(isNull({ZONE VALID TO}) || trim({ZONE VALID TO}) == '', toTimestamp(null()), toTimestamp(toString({ZONE VALID TO}, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		EID as string,
		EXPECTEDENDDATE as string,
		ZONE_VALID_TO as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ELID as string,
		UploadDate as string,
		MANAGER_LASTNAME as string,
		AVAILABLE_TO_WORK as string,
		MANAGER_EMAIL as string,
		FIRSTNAME as string,
		ZONEOWNEREMAIL as string,
		EMAIL as string,
		VENDOR_COMPANY as string,
		ZONE_NAME as string,
		ZONE_VALID_FROM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MANAGER_NAME as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		HIRE_DATE as string,
		LASTNAME as string,
		ACCESS_KEEPER_ID as string,
		MANAGER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		JOBTITLE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EID,
		EXPECTEDENDDATE = {EXPECTED END DATE},
		ZONE_VALID_TO = ZONEVALIDTO,
		ELID,
		UploadDate,
		MANAGER_LASTNAME = {MANAGER LAST NAME},
		AVAILABLE_TO_WORK = {AVAILABLE TO WORK},
		MANAGER_EMAIL = {MANAGER EMAIL},
		FIRSTNAME = {FIRST NAME},
		ZONEOWNEREMAIL = {ZONE OWNER EMAIL},
		EMAIL,
		VENDOR_COMPANY = {VENDOR COMPANY},
		ZONE_NAME = {ZONE NAME},
		ZONE_VALID_FROM = ZONEVALIDFROM,
		MANAGER_NAME = {MANAGER NAME},
		ETLUser,
		HIRE_DATE = {HIRE DATE},
		LASTNAME = {LAST NAME},
		ACCESS_KEEPER_ID = {ACCESS KEEPER ID},
		MANAGER_FIRST_NAME = {MANAGER FIRST NAME},
		JOBTITLE = {JOB TITLE}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
